summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and retail developments, with a focus on inflation and regulatory changes affecting the industry.

bullets.text: Supreme Court stays trial against Rahul Gandhi for his "commander-in-thief" remark about PM Modi.
India's retail inflation accelerated to 5.54% in September, up from 4.83% in August, marking a near two-year high.
FSSAI plans to amend laws to enhance accountability for online food delivery platforms amid ongoing inspections.
IKEA aims for 4x revenue growth in India by 2030, expanding its store network from eight to thirty.
The Indian rupee strengthened 177 paise against the US dollar to 94.06 following RBI's market interventions.
